info.name: Banking lab · e2e stories
info.description:
A mirror of the ExUnit stories in apps/e2e/test/stories, to replay them by hand as a double check. The ExUnit stories are the source of truth (docs, D15): change a story there first, then mirror it here in the same commit.

Run a whole folder with the Collection Runner: the `Wait until …` requests repeat themselves until they pass (up to 10 s), which only works in the Runner or Newman. Select the `local` environment first.

item.name: opening a customer account opens its ledger account
02 · Wait until the ledger account is open

exec: // eventually: repeat this request until it passes, for up to 10 s.
const ok = (() => { try { return pm.response.code === 200 && json.status === "open"; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test("the ledger account is open", () => pm.expect(ok, JSON.stringify(json)).to.be.true);
